scope: web-prose draft strategy guides (written articles), NOT YouTube transcripts; outside the src/ingest ETL
note: Each set's guide is hand-captured from a Draftsim article URL. sha1 = shasum of the committed <SET>.md. Distinct from grades/draftsim_<SET>.json, which holds Draftsim's numeric pick-order grades.

FRA.note: Unlike the other sets here this file HAS a '## Card notes' section — the FRA article is a per-card set review, so it feeds the card-reference tiles as well as grades/draftsim_FRA.json (0-10 rescaled to /5).
FRA.evidence_note: Pre-release; the reviewer states the ratings are initial impressions with no games played.

TRK.note: Per-card set review like FRA: has a '## Card notes' section and feeds grades/draftsim_TRK.json (0-10 rescaled to /5). Four land cycles graded as groups (grade applied per land, no notes). Stardates bonus sheet keyed by original card names.
TRK.evidence_note: Pre-release; the reviewer states the ratings are initial impressions.
